$comment: WO036-2: promote 4 retargeted rows (cls dialog) — react-port contract specs for dialog-level entries. These 4 cls-dialog tokens (dialogdepth.plugins-close, dialogdepth.ocr-cancel, dialogdepth.ai-propose-cancel, dialogdepth.speech-close) were override-only with legacy dialog-action assertions in dlg-plugins-other.json for the retired vanilla bundle. In the React canvas editor: plugin buttons (ocr/speech/ai-*) open rails [data-wo-right-panel="plugins" or "ai-assistant"]; the legacy #btn-plugins-close/#btn-ocr-cancel/#btn-ai-propose-cancel/#btn-speech-close DOM does not exist. Promotion replaces the legacy assertion with a React contract (dom-mutation on the right panel), making these rows non-retarget.
